title: Experiencers' account of breeding experiments and ecological messages

tellings.quote: following seems to be their story not my story but their story they're doing freting experiments for reasons we don't know

plain: Nonhuman beings are said to be doing breeding experiments on people "for reasons we don't know" and to be giving out messages about the environment. A guest named Bob McGwier, whom the episode's title calls a CIA contractor, passes this on from experiencers, people who say they have had contact with such beings, and is careful to call it "their story, not my story." If true, the contact would have a purpose of its own: breeding humans and warning them about the planet.
